龙湘还怕小师妹没练过锦香宫心法，受不住温夫人的音波，难以担任护法，殊不知她的天地无声势比之玄烛心经远有过之而无不及，专心一意，天地之间无声可闻，音波功对她的影响微乎其微，没人比她更适合护法。=Long Xiang worries that Little Junior Sister, not having practiced Jinxiang Palace's Heart Method, cannot withstand Madam Wen's sound waves and would struggle to serve as a protector. 龙湘远远的看见，心跳顿时漏了一拍，飞奔过来，看得无比真切，却吶吶说不出话来，在可能为数不多的日子里，以为再也见不到的人回来了，眼泪先不争气落了下来。=Seeing from afar, Long Xiang's heart skipped a beat. She dashed over, seeing him clearly yet stammering speechlessly. In what might have been her limited days left, the person she thought she'd never see again had returned—tears fell uncontrollably.
龙湘追出，不消须臾，只听雨中一声悲鸣，除了雨声，再也没有动静。=Long Xiang chased after him, and in just a moment, a mournful cry was heard in the rain. Then only sound of the rain remained.
龙湘闻言一怔，旋即哑然失笑。=Long Xiang, hearing this, paused, then laughed soundlessly.
龙湘颊上犹带泪痕，却笑得春光明媚，你不禁看得痴了。=Tear stains still remained on Long Xiang's cheeks, but she smiled with spring-like radiance. You couldn't help but stare, mesmerized.
